# LaxVault

> LaxVault is a lacrosse practice planner and drill diagram tool for volunteer youth and high school coaches. Draw drills, build timed practice plans, run them live from the sideline, and print them for the field.

LaxVault is made by Vaultline Sports LLC (Clarksville, Tennessee, USA), the company behind GridIronVault (flag football playbook studio). Each product has its own site and account.

- Marketing site: https://lax-vault.com/
- App: https://app.lax-vault.com/
- Support and terms: https://app.lax-vault.com/terms · https://app.lax-vault.com/privacy

## What it does

- Drill library: 33 starter lacrosse drills with setup, coaching points, gear and a diagram, plus your own drills.
- Timed practice planner: build a practice script of timed periods and pick drills for each one.
- Live practice mode: a big period clock, the drill on screen, horn at zero, built for a phone on the sideline.
- "Build tonight's practice": pick age group, kind of night and minutes, get a ready plan in seconds.
- Diagram editor: men's field, women's field and box lacrosse, half and full views; sets for each game (men's 2-3-1, 1-4-1, 2-2-2, 1-3-2, man-up 3-3; women's 1-4-2, 2-3-2, 1-3-3; box 2-2-1, power play 3-2; man-to-man, zones, man-down and penalty kill); cut / pass / pick / dodge lines; Run play animates a play step by step.
- Player link (Coach and up): one link or QR code puts a playbook on players' phones; each player sees their job on every play and takes a play quiz whose scores go to the coach.
- Team logo and colors on prints, live mode and the player link (Coach and up). Hudl and YouTube film links on plays and drills (every plan).
- Print and export: practice script, drill cards, PDF and PowerPoint.

## Who it is for

Volunteer youth and high school lacrosse coaches: boys' and girls' field lacrosse and box lacrosse.

## Pricing

- Sideline: free. 15 drills and plays, 1 playbook, letter-page print with watermark.
- Coach: $5 a month or $39 a year, or a $15 Season Pass (four months). 400 drills and plays, clean prints.
- Staff: $12 a month or $99 a year. Everything in Coach, for a head coach plus 3 assistants.
- League pack: $199 a year, 15 seats.
- Founding Coach: $29 a year for life, every Coach tool, for the first 250 coaches only (live count on the home page).
- Every paid plan has a 14-day money-back guarantee. Cancel any time.
